title: Rating the Raters: Rasch Measurement Theory for LLM Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.27463v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLMs now sit on every side of evaluation: as examinees scored on benchmarks, judges of other models' outputs, and raters of human-generated content. Each paradigm can be viewed as a measurement problem, where a latent property of an object is probed with items from an instrument (e.g., benchmark) by judges or raters. Standard evaluation practices often neglect the contributions of each core component to the end result, limiting our understanding of what is being measured. Rasch measurement theory (RMT) is well-suited to this problem. RMT decomposes ordinal ratings into separable facets on a common scale. It further provides a battery of diagnostics that can identify miscalibrated measurements and rater biases. We present a case study of RMT applied to the LLM-as-rater paradigm using the Measuring Hate Speech corpus, whose construct was itself built under RMT. translated_title: 评估评估者：用于大语言模型评估的Rasch测量理论
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）如今已渗透到评估的方方面面：既作为被试在基准测试中被评分，又作为评判者对其他模型的输出进行评判，还作为评分者对人类生成的内容进行打分。每一种范式都可以被看作一个测量问题，即由评判者或评分者使用来自某种工具（如基准测试）的题目来探究对象的潜在属性。标准的评估实践往往忽视各个核心组件对最终结果的贡献，限制了我们对“究竟在测量什么”的理解。Rasch测量理论（RMT）非常适合解决这一问题。RMT将有序评分分解为同一量表上可分离的多个侧面，并提供一系列诊断方法，能够识别失准的测量和评分者的偏差。我们以“LLM作为评分者”范式为例，基于“测量仇恨言论”语料库开展了RMT应用案例研究，该语料库的构念本身就是在RMT框架下构建的。我们对九个大语言模型的标注数据拟合了一系列多侧面Rasch模型……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文将Rasch测量理论引入大语言模型评估，把评估视为测量问题，将评分分解为可分离的多个侧面以诊断测量失准与评分者偏差，并在九个LLM标注仇恨言论语料库的案例中加以验证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Rasch Measurement Theory (RMT) to LLM evaluation, treating it as a measurement problem and decomposing ratings into separable facets to diagnose miscalibration and rater bias, demonstrated through a case study of nine LLMs rating the Measuring Hate Speech corpus.
